entries.text: Complete all courses listed below unless otherwise indicated. college: College of Social Sciences and Humanities
overview_text: Africana studies is an interdisciplinary field of study devoted to the critical and systematic examination of the cultural, political, social, economic, and historical experiences of the African Diaspora across the globe. Students are able to focus on either African American, African, or Africana studies.
